reviewPrompt: Review the analysis rating and choose what to do next.
basicHint: Ready without an API key: review market evidence and portfolio risk rules. This mode does not use a language model or predict target prices.
aiHint: Uses your configured model for evidence review, bull/bear perspectives and risk checks. Your provider's usage charges may apply.
language: New reports will be written in {{language}}.
stockDescription: Enter a ticker to start an analysis here. The report will show the sources, review steps and risk checks.
noTickers: No eligible stocks found. Add a holding or analyze one stock.
failed: Could not start analysis. Please retry.
partial: Some stocks could not be queued
loadError: Could not load run status. Refresh to try again.
reportHint: Saved reports include evidence, review steps and risk checks. New reports use the language selected when you start analysis.
traceDescription: A reviewable summary of the data, key arguments and checks used to reach the result.
basicReport: Free basic review: deterministic rules and available evidence. No AI debate or price forecast was generated.
noSources: No usable evidence was returned. Treat the result as incomplete.
missingSettings: Could not check API settings. Refresh before starting analysis.
keyUnavailable: The saved model key is unavailable. Re-enter it in Settings before running AI analysis.
